mentions.name: Safe Drive
mentions.description: Mobile app that provides feedback on the driver's performance along their daily route, showing where they brake hard or drive smoothly and warning them a few seconds in advance at spots where they often brake hard. Still early stage, with plans to explore hardware such as a Raspberry Pi with OpenAuto to gain object-distance awareness around the car.
mentions.problem: A driver who learned only a couple of years ago wants feedback on their driving and advance warnings about hard-braking spots on their familiar daily route to build confidence.
mentions.source_excerpt: Safe Drive - Mobile app for my car. I learned driving couple of years back only. Everyday, I travel same route. So decided to create a small mobile app first, which will provide me feedback about my driving.
mentions.author: giis
